name: cran/surveillance
what_it_is: An R package implementing statistical methods for temporal and spatio-temporal modeling and prospective monitoring of infectious disease count data. It provides aberration detection algorithms, endemic-epidemic regression models, and tools for nowcasting reporting delays.
components: sts (surveillance time series) S4 data class for multivariate count time series
Prospective outbreak detection algorithms (farringtonFlexible, categoricalCUSUM, algo.glrnb, algo.bayes, algo.cdc, earsC, boda, bodaDelay)
hhh4() endemic-epidemic model for multivariate areal count time series
twinSIR() SIR event history model for fixed-population point processes
twinstim() self-exciting spatio-temporal point process model
Calibration and scoring rules (DSS, LogS, RPS)
Simulation utilities (sts_creation, hhh4 simulate, twinSIR simulate, twinstim simulate)
Visualization: temporal, spatial, and spatio-temporal plots; animation support
measurement: Observed case counts per time unit and region
Proper scoring rules: Dawid-Sebastiani Score (DSS), Log Score (logs), Ranked Probability Score (RPS)
Nowcast prediction intervals for occurred-but-not-yet-reported events
Log-likelihood and AIC/BIC from endemic-epidemic model fits
configuration: farringtonFlexible: lookback years, half-window width, reweighting flag, time-trend inclusion, GLM family
hhh4 control: AR/NE/endemic formula components, lag, neighbourhood weight matrix, family, optimizer settings, random effects
nowcast: aggregation unit, maximum delay, moving window, prior distribution, MCMC settings
twinstim: endemic and epidemic formula, spatial/temporal interaction functions, epidemic link function
twinSIR: penalized likelihood smoothing parameter, covariate matrices
Simulation: outbreak sizes, outbreak dates, reporting delay density, overdispersion, seasonality harmonics
modes: Prospective (online) outbreak detection on count time series
Simulation of outbreak-contaminated count time series
SIR event-history modeling for fixed populations (twinSIR)
constraints: R >= 3.6.0 is required; no Python, Julia, or standalone binary interface is provided
hhh4 requires at least one lagged observation; the first time point cannot be modeled
nowcast bayes.trunc.ddcp method requires the runjags package and JAGS to be installed separately
No REST API, streaming interface, or network protocols; all computation is in-process R session only
No contact tracing, phylogenetic, or genomic analysis functionality
No dashboard or web UI; visualization is R plots only
notable_absences: No REST or gRPC API; purely an R library
No real-time data ingestion or database connectors
